class.name: NNBTConditionLeaf
class.brief_description: Base class for behaviour tree condition leaves that perform instant checks.
class.description: Use for custom yes/no checks in a behaviour tree. Override [method NNBTTaskNodes.on_tick] to return [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] or [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] immediately; returning [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] reports an error. For multi-tick actions, use [NNBTActionLeaf] instead.
